_comment: Repairs for `disproved` rows in commit-ledger-receipts.json — a test that exists, runs, passes and does NOT notice its own behaviour disappearing. Each entry names the NEW check and the exact mutation that was watched go red on the production path. These are deliberately NOT prover receipts: the prover scopes its run to the Test functions the original commit added, so a repair living in a new file cannot flip that commit's verdict. The row stays `disproved` — correctly, because the commit's OWN test still does not bite — and this file records that the behaviour is now covered by something else.

repairs.subject: weighing capture slots, answers and kinds on the SOP rules, submits and observations
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: TestWeighingCaptureDTOsMatchTheirOpenAPISchemas ran the schema->DTO direction over the `required` list only, and almost nothing here is required — a capture field is optional so an older app that sends neither keeps working. Dropping proofs/answers from both submit requests tripped neither check.
repairs.repair: backend/internal/weighing/adapters/http/capture_contract_test.go — every DECLARED property must be emitted, not only the required ones
repairs.result: RED, naming proofs and answers on both submit requests

repairs.subject: resolve an item's category kind through the cheap walk, not the counted projection
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: the commit's only test change was a compile-stub CategoryKind on an existing fake; it asserted nothing about the write path.
repairs.repair: backend/internal/configuration/app/kind_resolution_test.go — a counting fake proves the item write asks CategoryKind and never reads the categories register, on Create and on Update
repairs.mutation: restore s.repo.Get(ctx, tenantID, RegCategories, ...) in Service.kindFor
repairs.result: RED on both subtests and both counters

repairs.subject: restore the feed columns lost in the merge
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: every register test asserts a register the merge had left internally consistent; a column that vanished agrees with itself, so no fixture built out of the register could represent the failure. The commit's own new test covered an unrelated migration grain move.
repairs.repair: backend/internal/configuration/domain/feed_item_authoring_test.go — the three ration keys named as literals and driven through the real validator, plus the medicine and mixed-sheet cases so it cannot be satisfied the wrong way
repairs.mutation: restore the pre-merge `unit` column and delete energy_kcal_per_kg / dry_matter_factor / wastage_factor
repairs.result: RED, reproducing the reported defect verbatim

repairs.subject: align stock loads read permission
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: TestGetStockLoadsAcceptsFeedDirectionReader grants RoleFeedDirector, which holds BOTH permissions of the OR. A principal holding both halves can never show which half is load-bearing.
repairs.repair: backend/internal/feeddirection/adapters/http/stock_loads_scope_test.go — a principal holding ONLY FeedDirectionRead, plus a principal holding neither
repairs.mutation: narrow the handler back to permissions.FeedAnalyticsStockRead alone
repairs.result: RED with 403 'this route requires an authorized park scope', while the original test stayed green beside it

repairs.subject: read current Feed card state on each Work Board request
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: not the test's fault in the way the word implies — every Postgres test in feeddirection/adapters/boardsource died at seed time on the sop_proofs check constraint added by migration 000342, so the suite could not run at all.
repairs.repair: backend/internal/feeddirection/adapters/boardsource/source_integration_test.go — the fixture derives sop_proofs the way the write path does, reviving all eight tests
repairs.mutation: let a card value outlive its request
repairs.result: RED: 'stale feed summary after complete: map[in_progress:2 rejected:2]'

repairs.subject: stop the Closed, No Dose drawer fanning out on multi-tag animals
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: its own test is sound and bites at HEAD (verified). Checking why the row read disproved found the SAME defect unfixed in the sibling query, vaccinationGapsSQL, whose fixture gives no animal any tag so the case cannot arise in it.
repairs.repair: backend/internal/vaccinationexecution/adapters/postgres/gaps_multi_tag_fanout_test.go, and the LATERAL fix in repository.go
repairs.mutation: red-first: the test fails on the unchanged query with 'appears 2 times, want 1'
repairs.result: a real defect, fixed — on a keyset-paginated scan the duplicate spends a LIMIT slot and distinct gapped animals fall off the page

repairs.subject: apply work_state/severity filters to card summaries query
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: the fix is in SQL; the test it shipped lives in app/service_test.go and is served by a hand-written fakeRepo that was taught the same filtering. Reverting the SQL cannot reach the fake, so the test proves the fake works.
repairs.repair: none needed — the behaviour IS covered, by TestVaccinationExecutionCardSummariesStatusMatrix... in adapters/postgres
repairs.mutation: neutralise the $6 work_state predicate in the card-summaries SELECT
repairs.result: RED. A mis-scoped ledger row rather than an uncovered behaviour; the app-layer fake should not be read as SQL proof.

repairs.subject: the verifier's card shows the pen, not a shed UUID
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: it does bite at HEAD (verified). The stored verdict is stale.
repairs.mutation: put the shed id and the Pen fragment back into feedDistributionSubjectLabel

repairs.subject: satisfy blind verification landing guards
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: mis-scoping, not a weak test: its only test file is verificationcatalog/catalog_test.go (a migration filename) while its code change is 230 lines in weighing/adapters/postgres. The prover ran the first and reverted the second.
repairs.repair: none — the row is unprovable in this shape, not uncovered

repairs.subject: retire operator, move the farm onto manager roles
repairs.whyItDidNotBite: TestHerdOperationsIsNeverOfferedFromARoleGrant feeds two grant sets that contain no operator role, so re-adding the branch the commit deleted changes nothing for them. The fixture cannot represent a principal who still holds the retired grant — the test pins current behaviour, not required behaviour.
repairs.repair: none here — this commit is NOT an ancestor of this branch, so the code it changed does not exist in this tree. Repair belongs on the lane that carries it.
